description:
We are Team ASTRA, a group of middle school, high school, and college students collaborating with an experienced software engineer. Passionate about space exploration, AI, and robotics, we're building an astronaut health monitoring system using wearable sensors, Raspberry Pi, and local SI to detect risks and deliver alerts. Our strengths include programming, electronics, and engineering. 

We welcome teammates interested in health sciences, biomedical engineering, SI, and UI/UX design. Join us!
